description: Fantastic-2 is a team of two high school friends interested in coding, AI, Data science, and much more. We see this as an opportunity to learn, discover and evolve.
summary: NASA Hardware: Still Out There is an interactive website about NASA spacecraft and exploration vehicles left on the Moon and Mars. Visitors choose a mission and read a student-friendly story beside NASA photographs and links to mission sources. Each story explains what the spacecraft was built to do, what it found, and how its mission ended, using NASA mission records as the basis for creative non-fiction. The project responds to “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” by helping students see these machines as more than old hardware: they remain part of the story of exploration, scientific discovery, and the questions future missions will build on.
details: NASA Hardware: Still Out There is a browser-based story archive about NASA spacecraft and exploration equipment left on the Moon and Mars. Visitors choose a mission, view NASA imagery, and read a continuous creative nonfiction story based on mission records. Each story explains what the machine was built to do, what scientists learned from it, and how its work ended. A hidden homepage interaction takes a cutout image of the Sun through a collapse and supernova before revealing a rotating black hole. We built the site in Visual Studio Code with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; it needs no special hardware. The project is designed for students, with readable stories and simple mission browsing. We considered factual accuracy, source credit, accessibility, and use on phones and laptops. It aims to make the history of these missions engaging while showing why their work still matters.
